Today’s Production Update

Production started at 7:30 AM without any issues.

Maintenance arrived, and production was temporarily stopped to adjust the Theegarten rails, as caramel was sticking to them.

At approximately 9:40 AM, production was stopped again to realign the Guillotine Belt.

At 10:30 AM, excess salt was detected in the product. All affected product was removed from the line, and production restarted at 11:25 AM.

The metal detector operated without any issues throughout the shift.

I’m not sure why the belt got dirty so quickly, especially since this happened before we started adjusting the tunnel temperatures. I’ve also noticed that these issues started happening after the belt was replaced.
